name: ru-it-outsource-dd
description: M&A due diligence skills for Russian small IT-outsourcing targets (sysadmin B2B, MSB up to 100M RUB/year). Covers whitening (gray-to-white EBITDA reconstruction), tax risks (54.1 NK, USN splits, IT-accreditation), 152-FZ/KII compliance, multi-entity reconciliation, and RSBU financial audit. See RU_ADAPTATION_PLAN.md for full scope.
